property_summary: For any deposit activity, SetMinSum remains callable while the contract is uninitialized (the reentrancy lock is released after every external call), so SetMinSum(v2) always succeeds and MinSum equals the last value set; the mutant never releases the lock, so a Put before SetMinSum makes SetMinSum revert and MinSum keeps its old value.
change_summary: Delete `locked_ = false;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released and later SetMinSum calls revert.
